description: On-Chain Bytecode & Unverified Token Trap Detector — Reads live Base bytecode, proxy slots (EIP-1967/beacon/zeppelinos/EIP-1822/EIP-1167), ERC-20 state, and privileged selectors to score honeypot and rug risk in code: SAFE | CAUTION | HONEYPOT_RUG | INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Adds honeypot.is buy/sell simulation and GoPlus tax and honeypot flags, disclosed per source, and degrades to a lower-confidence bytecode-only score when they fail.

sourceCode.description: Optional Solidity source claimed for the token.

name: token-trap-detector
